blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Former Vice President and current Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo should decide by January 2027 whether to run for president in 2028 to give herself enough time to prepare for the campaign. This is what Naga City Vice Mayor Gaby Bordado said in a phone interview on Thursday (November 5). Bordado said political experts knowledgeable about presidential and vice presidential candidates had advised Robredo to make an early announcement if she intended to run. He said the experts, whose names he declined to disclose, noted that Robredo’s late declaration of candidacy was among the criticisms raised during the […]...
